title: WorkTraceEvent
description: One unit of work a run did for the reader, re-sent as it changes. The latest event for a step_id replaces earlier ones. Built by hubofhubs.ports.trace.project from an allowlist.

trace_id.description: The turn id; one trace per turn.

step_id.description: Stable per unit of work, so updates replace in place.

solution_id.description: The hub seat id. Never an arm name.

kind.description: sources, papers, records, check, action or notice; an unknown kind renders as one generic row.

label_key.description: An i18n key, never display text.

ref.description: A domain for sources, an id for other kinds. Never a full URL or a path.

affects_user.description: True only when the person's result or wait changed.

ended_at.description: Present when state is done or failed.
